scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cloth-idea/domain && npm run build -w @cloth-idea/model-providers
scripts.build:weapp: npm run build:packages && npm run build:weapp -w @cloth-idea/client
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @cloth-idea/domain && npm run dev:h5 -w @cloth-idea/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && node --env-file=.env.local --watch --import tsx apps/server/src/index.ts
